items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: I think Willie Hunter was the one.

ctx.x: In the old days, did most of the fellas on the street use an E flat or the big one? E flat. That's right, the little one, E flat, most of them. None of them couldn't pay no B home. I'm forgetting now who started that dog.
I think Willie Hunter was the one. He used to go E flat too. On a parade. He quit. He wanted to use the B flat. Yeah.
